_lane: coldstart_ladder_20260820 -- a third cold start from the same seed, on the evidence-ladder-v2 code
_what_this_measures: This lane is the PAIRED CONTROL for coldstart_newgate_20260819. Same seed (examples/tasks/dense_bf16_gemm_fused, byte-identical to git), same 11-case suite, same immutable rocBLAS oracle, same budget 12, same six GPUs, same min_improve and candidate_floor. The one thing that changed is the workflow code: the evidence ladder was rebuilt (686d9521). L3 no longer reads a disassembly -- ir_capture.py replays the build's own device compile with -mllvm -print-changed=quiet and ir_signals.py ranks adjacent-pass deltas, so L3 returns a PASS and a STRUCTURE instead of register counts naming no pass. L4 is now entered inside the same round on needs_compiler instead of waiting for a round that the stop budget ends first, and it consults perf_knowledge/compiler_grounding/ before any source. A refutation now routes TO L3 rather than past it. The evidence record is versioned (geak.evidence-ladder/v2), so a round banked before this existed reads as legacy_machine_code and satisfies no rung. So the difference between this lane's round-by-round curve and coldstart_newgate_20260819's is attributable to the ladder rather than to a different starting point.
_prior_lanes_for_reference: greedy_coldstart_20260817 ended at suite geomean 1.4045 under the SUITE commit gate. coldstart_newgate_20260819 reached cumulative 1.2707 by wave 5 with 31 insights and 30 ledger entries under the per-route band gate. Both are read-only history. Neither is a seed for this lane, and neither number is a target to beat -- they are the curves this one is compared against.
_note_state_dir: A NEW, EMPTY directory. That is the whole point: with no <state_dir>/best on disk the director seeds from kernel_path and returns resumed:false, which is a true cold start. It must NOT be pointed at exp/state_coldstart_newgate_20260819 (cumulative 1.2707, 31 insights, 30 ledger entries), at exp/state_greedy_coldstart_20260817 (the 1.4045 incumbent), or at any exp/task_bf16_* / exp/v98_* / exp/qd_* directory. From round 1 onward the lane fills this directory itself, so 'cold start' and 'runs continuously across machine restores' are not in conflict.
_note_ladder_switches_are_explicit_on_pu: isa_evidence and ir_diagnostics are the two switches that decide whether the thing this lane exists to measure runs at all: LADDER_ENABLED = ISA_ENABLED && IR_DIAGNOSTICS (kernel_lane.js:664). Both values here are IDENTICAL to the built-in defaults -- verified against kernel_lane.js:606-608 (empty or unrecognised isa_evidence resolves to 'observe') and :661 (ir_diagnostics defaults 'on') -- so passing them changes no behaviour whatsoever. They are passed anyway because an omitted key takes its default and NOTHING inside the run can distinguish that from a default that was intended; that is the exact failure lane_args.py was written for, and here it would apply to the lane's own experimental variable. The visible effect is in the Setup echo: 'isa_evidence=observe' and 'ir_diagnostics=on' now appear WITHOUT the '(default)' marker (the marker is driven by A[key] == null, kernel_lane.js:1227), so the log states that the ladder was chosen rather than inherited. Pinned in _require so a future edit cannot quietly drop them.
_note_isa_stays_at_observe: 'observe', not 'gate'. The ISA layer is the VERIFICATION receipt -- did the rewrite reach the binary -- and gating on it has never run for real. Two credibility fixes landed with the ladder (code-object SHA-256 digests preferred over the opcode-multiset test for unchanged_machine_code, and realized_in / realized_outside_target reporting WHICH kernel satisfied a claim), and both need a wave of verdicts read by hand before anything is enforced on them. Promote to 'gate' only after that inspection, and only as a deliberate, recorded change.
_note_min_improve: 0.005 carried over from both prior lanes unchanged, so all three remain comparable. It matters less than it did -- the per-route band gate is the default path -- but it is still the fallback threshold on any round where no band table can be derived, and still the denominator the union commit gate falls back to.
_note_gpu_ids: Six lanes, ids 2-7, identical to both prior lanes, so round parallelism -- and therefore the shape of the budget curve -- matches the lanes this one is compared against. Verified free on tw045 before launch by gpu_lock's own criteria (busy<=5% and vram<=1024MB read from /sys/class/drm/renderD(128+8*id)/device): all eight cards read busy=0% and vram_used=283MB, i.e. driver-only. Use those criteria, not rocm-smi, whose numbering does not agree with gpu_lock's and is not the one that decides.
_note_route_bands: RESOLVED at launch by lane_args.py from noise_floor_stats' table for the CURRENT epoch (8 same-variant primed repeats, 2*MAD/median), never written down here. Writing today's numbers into this file is exactly how route_bands_gfx942_epochQ.json went six epochs stale while still looking like a current measurement: the floors belong to the box, and this container changes box every few hours. The table can only TIGHTEN the gate -- every route is held to MIN_ROUTE_WIN (2%) unless a sweep measured that route noisier than that. If this epoch's floors were never measured, --check REFUSES before the wave starts rather than handing the gate a table of fail-closed defaults that would silently hold every route to ~7% for the whole run. NOTE FOR THE FIRST WAVE ON A NEW BOX: this refusal is expected until the epoch is registered AND deprovisionalized. tw045 is unregistered as of launch; letters L..C are burned, so the next letter is D. Register, sweep, deprovisionalize, then --check.

_not_passed_on_purpose.compiler_source_dir: Omitted = empty, which is what this image wants. L4 Tier 2 is an optional read-only AMDGPU checkout; this image ships no backend sources, and compiler_engineer.md is written to finish on Tier 0 (perf_knowledge/compiler_grounding/) and Tier 1 (optimization remarks) or return inconclusive rather than reconstruct pass behaviour from memory. Pointing this at a checkout that does not match the installed toolchain would be worse than leaving it empty.
_not_passed_on_purpose.search_strategy: REMOVED. It matched nothing after the QD search was deleted and the entry point now throws on it. Greedy is the only strategy.

task: cold-start run on the evidence-ladder-v2 code, paired against coldstart_newgate_20260819; target the 11-case suite geomean vs direct rocblas_gemm_ex
_note_candidate_floor: 0.29, a RECORDED DEVIATION from the 1.0 default, carried over unchanged from coldstart_newgate_20260819 where it was added after that lane's wave 1 round 1 committed nothing. Reason: on this task the PRIMARY metric is fixed by the harness as speedup vs the IMMUTABLE rocBLAS oracle, and the seed sits at 0.336 -- the candidate tree starts BELOW its own comparator. kernel_lane.js admits a verified result to the round's candidate list only when primSpeedup > CANDIDATE_FLOOR, so at the 1.0 default every result during the entire climb from 0.336 to rocBLAS parity is filtered out, WINNER stays null, and the per-route gate -- which sits behind `if (winner && ROUTE_BANDS)` -- can never run. 0.29 sits below the seed control (0.3353) by more than the widest measured route band, so no real work is dropped, while an engineer that honestly reports worse-than-seed still skips verification via the trustworthyBelowBaseline economy. The COMMIT decision is untouched: banking still requires the per-route band gate or MIN_IMPROVE over `cumulative`, so this changes what is TRACKED, not what is BANKED.
_note_pairing: Against coldstart_newgate_20260819 this is a single-variable comparison: every knob in this file is that lane's value, and the only difference is the workflow code. Against greedy_coldstart_20260817 it is not -- that lane ran the 1.0 candidate_floor default and the suite gate. Read the three curves as 'suite gate' -> 'per-route gate + reachable candidate list' -> 'the same plus an IR-grounded ladder'.
